notes: Enacted PL 119-55 (2 sections, 1 page). Single-source audit: primary bill text only; no referencedSources registered on the cache entry. featured_quotes (one CR floor statement by Rep. Van Orden) is NOT decomposed here — its Congressional Record source was not fetched to bill-text/ref-text, so it is unverifiable against available source; out of the bill-text decomposition scope. Analysis fidelity is very high: it reproduces the source's own typo 'chapter 31 33, or 35' in the struck (e) text and correctly distinguishes the (c) covered-chapter list ('chapter 30, 31, 33, or 35') from the (e) list ('chapter 31, 33, or 35'). Only non-SUPPORTED rows are 2 minor: (1) summary quotes the paragraph-(6) insert WITH a trailing comma though the source inserts it without one (substance correct; other surfaces render it right); (2) an unsourced interpretive rationale that the two-tier date 'lets institutions and the VA adjust'. No material issues.
